g.text: Conflict = WANT0 & WANT1 & equal(all four active address bits). It disables BOTH bank families and asynchronously clears route validation.

g.desc: Conflict = WANT0 & WANT1 & equal(all four active address bits). It disables BOTH bank families and asynchronously clears route validation.

g.text: Removing a conflict only removes its fault condition; it does not restore VALID. Release both WANTs, verify quiet, then explicitly rearm.

g.desc: Removing a conflict only removes its fault condition; it does not restore VALID. Release both WANTs, verify quiet, then explicitly rearm.

g.text: The two source enables may coexist only at different contacts. Common tissue impedance and volume conduction are outside this digital collision test.

g.desc: The two source enables may coexist only at different contacts. Common tissue impedance and volume conduction are outside this digital collision test.

g.text: ROUTE_LOCKED means admitted digital command ownership only. No selected-contact continuity or power-off isolation is inferred.

g.desc: ROUTE_LOCKED means admitted digital command ownership only. No selected-contact continuity or power-off isolation is inferred.

g.text: Sixteen selectable stimulation contacts, two dedicated monitored returns; command-level routing is not measured continuity or isolation.

g.desc: Sixteen selectable stimulation contacts, two dedicated monitored returns; command-level routing is not measured continuity or isolation.
